payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methodologies and metrics used to evaluate the quality of the data, including empirical evidence, filtering criteria, and error rates.

claims.text: The quality of the data is empirically evaluated through a standardized measure of model stability against different speakers, indicated by the CoefVar_MS metric.
The dataset is filtered by sentence lengths to ensure that the evaluation set is more representative of real-world scenarios, which contributes to quality assessment.
Word error rate (WER) and character error rate (CER) are used as metrics to evaluate the performance of ASR models, reflecting data quality.
